            global_var:oe_y1_m >= 584
            OR = {
                NOT = { oe_y1_ok_13 = yes }
                global_var:oe_y1_m > oe_y1_cut_13
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Every scheduled event has fired or been dropped.
oe_y1_all_done = {
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_1
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_2
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_3
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_4
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_5
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_6
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_10
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_11
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_12
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_st_13
}

# Any scope. The schedule is open: not every event is settled and month 585 (1370.8) is not reached.
oe_y1_sched_open = {
    has_global_variable = oe_y1_m
    global_var:oe_y1_m < 585
    NOT = { oe_y1_all_done = yes }
}
